description: Final working state: 28.1% coverage (33,633/119,699 lines). Added CoreLogicTests, PipelineTypesTests, ToolTypesTests, SpeechInputStageTests, BargeInStateTests. Removed broken FalseInterruptionRecoveryTests. Coverage report at autoresearch/untestable-report.md documents ~35K untestable lines (SwiftUI views, framework deps, complex coordinators).

hypothesis.final_assessment: Realistic max coverage without production code changes is ~30-35%. The gap to 90% requires either: (1) Extracting view models from 25K+ lines of SwiftUI views, (2) Creating mock protocols for AVFoundation/MLX/SoundAnalysis deps, (3) Refactoring PipelineCoordinator (8K lines). These are significant architectural changes.

learnings: swift test --enable-code-coverage requires llvm-profdata merge of .profraw files from .build/arm64-apple-macosx/debug/codecov/
Coverage denominator includes ALL instrumented code (120K lines), making each % point require ~1,200 additional executed lines
SwiftUI views (.body) are essentially untestable without extracting view models
Many assumed type names/APIs don't match actual code — must read source before writing tests
